# discourse time (syuzhet)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisDiscourseTime`](gmeow-axisDiscourseTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisDiscourseTime>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The discourse-time axis — narrative position in the order of telling: chapter indices, scene ordinals, page positions. Owned by the telling work or expression; a re-segmented edition is a different discourse frame.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:NarrativeTimeAxis`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeTimeAxis.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:axisDiscourseTime`](gmeow-axisDiscourseTime.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:NarrativeTimeAxis`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativeTimeAxis.md).
